summary: Linkwarden is a self-hosted bookmark/link manager: users store links into collections (with shared membership), tag and annotate them (highlights), preserve them into multiple archive formats (screenshot/pdf/monolith/readable) via a background worker, search them (Meilisearch + Postgres substring), and manage optional paid subscriptions (Stripe/Apple/Google). API is Next.js REST over Prisma/PostgreSQL.
